title: Zoom desktop client data
whyItMatters: Zoom keeps local databases and logs for meetings, chat, contacts and settings here. The folder shows which accounts and meetings were used on this Mac.
source: Zoom Support, Clearing Zoom cache and cookies: macOS data folder ~/Library/Application Support/zoom.us - https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0058835
notes: Desktop client data. Local recordings are saved under ~/Documents/Zoom by default and are outside this locator. No database or log is opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save any local recording, chat file or note you need; recordings usually live in ~/Documents/Zoom.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of Zoom on this Mac and remove this device from the signed-in devices list in the Zoom web portal.
steps: Save the recordings and files you need.
Sign out of Zoom on this Mac.
Quit Zoom and move it to the Trash from Applications.
Delete the Zoom folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes local Zoom meeting, chat and settings data from this Mac. Cloud recordings and account data stay in the Zoom account.
cleanup.source: Zoom Support, Uninstalling and reinstalling the Zoom application: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0065146
